parsed.name: UART串口传输组件
parsed.description: 用于实验系统中的非实体软件通信组件，通过 UART 串口与下位机或控制电子学建立连接，并提供初始化、按地址写入、按地址读取和关闭连接等基础数据传输功能。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software communication component used in laboratory systems to connect to lower-level controllers or electronics over a UART serial link, providing basic transport functions such as initialization, address-based write, address-based read, and connection closure.

actions.description: 初始化 UART 串口通信连接。
actions.description_en: Initialize the UART serial communication link.
Write data to the specified address.

actions.description: 从指定地址读取指定长度的数据。
actions.description_en: Read a specified amount of data from the specified address.

actions.description: 关闭 UART 串口通信连接。
actions.description_en: Close the UART serial communication link.
